event.title: Remains of Climbers Missing for 34 Years Discovered in Swiss Alps
event.canonical_title: Remains of Climbers Missing for 34 Years Discovered in Swiss Alps
event.summary: The bodies of two Belgian climbers who disappeared in the Swiss Alps in 1992 have been recovered from a melting glacier, according to police reports. The Wallis police maintain records of missing persons dating back to 1925, primarily in mountainous regions and rivers.

timeline.title: Decades-Old Bodies of Missing Hikers Discovered in Swiss Alps Glacier
timeline.summary: The bodies of two Belgian mountaineers, missing for over 30 years in the Swiss Alps, have been uncovered due to melting glaciers. The hikers disappeared in the early 1990s, and their remains were found as climate change continues to impact glacial landscapes.
key_facts: Two Belgian mountaineers went missing in the Swiss Alps in the early 1990s.
Their bodies were found as glaciers melted.
